svg.title: Card fraud platform: deployment
svg.desc: Host tools and model servers, the Docker Desktop VM with the compose profiles above the kind cluster and its namespaces, the Azure resources of the IaC runs, and the internet services the platform uses.
svg.text: Deployment: one Windows host (Docker Desktop VM: compose profiles + a kind cluster), Azure for the IaC runs, SaaS on the internet
LLM B side of the A/B test
created per IaC run, then destroyed:
ansible over SSH, docker push, kubectl
built on the VM by Ansible
DOCKER DESKTOP · WSL2 VM · 8 GB RAM + 4 GB swap (.wslconfig)
pods -> lakehouse-s3:8333, kafka, ml-db, redis, mlflow, vector-db, scoring-api (node on fraud_default)
8 GB does not hold every profile: run stream alone; keep trino and dbt off while orch + gov run; Layer 3 runs with core + ml + CI/CD (profile cicd) and the kind cluster.
seaweedfs has the alias lakehouse-s3: inside kind, KFP's own seaweedfs Service shadows the short name.
The model servers run on the host GPU (GTX 1070, Pascal: no vLLM); llm-d's InferencePool selects thin bridge pods that forward to them.
Azure (docs/iac.md) exists only during an IaC run: created, checked, destroyed. Its quotas (6 vCPU and 3 public IPs per region, 0 for GPUs) keep the rest of the platform on the PC.
